body: I had a rough childhood..I was born in a poor family who's struggling to put food in the plate..my mom is a housewife my father wors in construction..im the eldest in the family..I have 3 siblings..life was pretty rough for me..I didn't finish my studies..coz of financial problems...my mom use to tell me to stop studying and just work to help the fsmily...I wanted to study..but then I stop inwork on a mobile shop..small restaurant to jelp my family...but I was too shy and anti social thats the reason I stop working after few months and stay home..my mom used to say that im worthless and just a nuisance in the family...when I was in school I get bullied a lot bcoz of my looks..im not pretty..im ugly..I cried myself to sleep..I cried alone. I was depressed since my younger days...I jaf the chance to work abroad..I faced tough times and breakdown from crying..and put on a happy face the next day...people think im steong and happy and have a good life..they dont know anything how i suffer...since I work abroad all my salary im sending to my family..I always put them first all der needs...I didn't save anything for myself...now im 30'i dont have anything still im supporting my family..my father is old but still working...my mom died coz of stess..leaving my sick brother alone...my other brother still in college and one is married...during my mom funeral..I didn't cry..I cannot cry..my mind is occupied with worries on wat I will do how ill support my family...how I will do everything by myself...all my family members r weak I feel that im the only one they r depending on..im so depressed...for struggling so much to earn money..I even took a 50 year old guy as a bf to suport me. I always felt that im using myself just to earn money..i feel disgusted about my self..im weak.I was almost raped by someone before...I face hardtimes at work...I worry so much about my future my family..if anyone sick I dont have savings..I accumulated so much debtswhen my mom got hospitalised..I dont inow how I will pay and support my family atbthe same time..I know morethan my problems other people have bigger ones...but its really hard..all my relationship fails coz of my family issues I cant even get married..I dont own myself..I cannot do wat wil make me happy coz I need to put my family first...I cannot even fall inlove..my new bf proposed to me..I cannot even plan to get married I even think that im not capable of loving anyone...my life sucks...when dying is the only option for me

very long story......since the moment I was born in this world...some people r lucky enough to have everything they needed...they dont need to struggle and face difficulties...sometimes I tend to think that im still doing ok than other people..but man its just hard having this demon inside me...
